status: source-only preparation; no GPU diagnostic or quality training executed
hypothesis: Conditional and unconditional learned-game VJPs may oppose one another inside the 71-site routed Supra host. The original two-site convergence toy lacks CFG and attention/LayerNorm coupling.
head: clean FAST saved tensors; no head selection, native serving swap or DV12 perturbation

contexts.selection: Private CPU7 generator; source IDs [4,5,15,16,17,18] in order; select first two entries of one randperm per source and sort those two actual indices. No scores consulted.
contexts.order: Three original B4 batches in declared index order; live teacher and student use exactly this same B4 CFG shape.
contexts.time_scope: Covers seven fit time values and all six sources, but only 12 contexts. This is a fixed local witness, not complete time/latent coverage.

panels.generator: private CPU72; one torch.randn([4,12,256,16]); then slice contexts into B4 batches
panels.same_for_all: Both arms, both fixed states and both common critics use identical raw panels.

objective.definition: Each draw uses softplus(D(real,source/time)-D(real+patchify(student_CFG-teacher_CFG)/fixed_scale,source/time)), after the unchanged critic pools token features into one context score. Average four draws per context.
objective.upstream: v = d context-game / d actual guided velocity; no output metric or surrogate gradient
objective.guided_vjp: g_total = J_guided^T v from the original actual graph
objective.per_context: Each of 12 contexts has its own four-draw mean and zero upstream force on the other B4 contexts. Report all owner/site/query decompositions separately.
objective.batch_mean: Also report the B4 mean game gradient, explicitly labeled as including cross-context summation. It is not substituted for within-context CFG cancellation.
objective.owners: All saved trainable generator parameters, each of 71 branches, all 71 router queries, shared router aggregate, and shared 128x4 bank.
objective.undefined: Cosine is null when either half norm is at or below the absolute floor. Cancellation and half-norm-relative discrepancy are null when sum of half norms is at or below the floor. Guided/conditional norm ratio and guided-relative discrepancy are null when their denominators are at or below the floor.
objective.decomposition_check: Record actual guided-gradient norm, half-sum norm, ||g_cond+g_uncond-g_total||, maximum absolute discrepancy, guided-relative error and half-norm-relative error. Mark decomposition_verified only when discrepancy <=1e-12+2e-4*(||g_cond||+||g_uncond||). A tiny guided norm does not set the acceptance tolerance. Report both half-sum/(sum of half norms) and direct guided/(sum of half norms). When the fixed bound is exceeded retain all observations with decomposition_verified=false and mark half-sum cancellation unverified, not faithful to the actual guided update. Do not abort observation solely for a legitimate finite-precision discrepancy or reinterpret it as an implementation failure. Separate BF16 reductions can round differently; no bitwise equality claim and no data-dependent threshold change.
objective.gate_capture: Observer delegates each public routing.mix exactly once and reads its actual clean code; a down forward hook observes actual hidden values. Diagnostic-only F.linear reproduces Hh+b and Cz to report each B4 CFG half's aggregate gate gains and preactivation magnitudes. Gate statistics aggregate tokens and the four contexts; the gradient decompositions retain individual contexts. No host function is replaced.

execution.prerequisite: Parent status complete at6400 and nonpartial independent-review.json qualified; explicit --qualified-review-sha256 must match the root-frozen final review file SHA256 and this card's expected reviewer/dependency source identities before any checkpoint/model/CUDA loading; no overlap with the active GPU process.
execution.budget_scope: Separate posthoc budget including source/input hashing, owner construction, all actual forwards/VJPs, immutability checks, source archive and report. No quality-triggered stop.
execution.completion_contract: Require completion.json complete=true bound to actual report SHA. Check the fixed 900-second deadline after report serialization/write, report SHA calculation and completion-receipt write. Receipt wall clock covers report write/SHA; the returned and logged final clock includes receipt write. A detected overrun preserves observations with incomplete report/completion/incomplete receipts and no quality qualification credit.
execution.timeout: Retain partial results with complete=false; no scientific qualification.

provenance.actual_checkpoint_shas: Bind and verify the qualified parent's actual800/6400 full checkpoint SHAs at launch; no fallback or other checkpoint.
provenance.actual_judges: Strictly load only saved FAST D1856 andV2D6400 tensors and verify their qualified tensor digests.
provenance.source: Verify all parent's held application/native/backend source SHAs plus the fixed independent reviewer and dependency; freeze the diagnostic/card SHA and archive exact source bytes at launch.
provenance.final_review: The explicit root-frozen --qualified-review-sha256 binds exact final JSON bytes; require full-review schema, qualified=true, partial=false, exact reviewer/dependency declared and actual file SHAs, and preserve the bound review file unchanged through execution.
provenance.isolation: Build isolated original host/router/encoder classes, strictly load actual saved FAST tensors/flags and bank, and use public RoutedRows for routing. No initializer reapplied to trained tensors; no optimizer/controller/policy/EMA constructed.
provenance.immutability: Compare all copied tensor values, module modes, trainable flags, .grad contents, hook identities, ordinary LoRA multiplier attributes and transient host frames before/after; preserve global CPU/CUDA RNG with fork_rng. Verify all original full input checkpoint files (including native optimizer/config/RNG/diagnostics) and held sources unchanged after execution.

limits: This is observational local conditioning, not proof of a unique convergence cause or a validated architecture repair.
Both original ordinary LoRA and particle Supra share CFG; a CFG witness alone cannot assign their difference to particles.
Source-balanced12 fit contexts are not a whole-pool result. Training, structural guards and checkpoint selection remain unchanged.
Gate statistics are actual-point algebraic observations; they do not independently certify full-model Jacobian conditioning or target reachability.

CPU strong-cancellation cases certify the numerical formula and FP32-owner/BF16-output-cast graph only. An extra BF16 matrix-reduction case exceeds the fixed 2e-4 half-norm bound and records decomposition_verified=false, retaining the direct guided norm. Actual frozen-BF16 Supra parity remains untested; an unverified half-sum is a numerical limitation rather than proof of an implementation defect or a convergence cause. This observation has no quality qualification or promotion credit.
Clean gradient decomposition does not measure DV12 gradient variance. The existing small clean-to-DV12 score differences describe the edge-time progress probe only.
Prior short late DV12/anchor/AMSGrad interventions used another source/checkpoint cohort and do not falsify an effect earlier in this fresh trajectory.
No output MSE/RMSE objective, optimizer intervention, quality or seed scan, metric-triggered horizon, best-state/head selection, or default promotion.
